device.description: 24-bit 105 kSPS wide-bandwidth delta-sigma ADC with SPI / frame-sync serial interface
device.note: ads1271.pdf (SBAS306F) p.4 electrical characteristics (digital I/O, DVDD), p.5 pin assignments and terminal functions, p.6 SPI-format timing, p.18 clock ratios (Table 3), p.19 mode selection (Table 5), format selection (Table 6), p.20-21 synchronization and power-down, p.25 data format (Table 9), SPI serial interface, DRDY

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: follows the MODE pin (0 = high-speed, 1 = low-power; float = high-resolution reads 0)

pages: p.4 (digital I/O, supplies), p.5 (pins), p.6 (SPI timing), p.18 (Table 3), p.19 (Tables 5, 6), p.20-21 (sync, power-down), p.25 (data format, SPI interface)
notModeled: only the SPI format (FORMAT = 0) is modeled; the frame-sync format (FORMAT = 1, DRDY/FSYNC an input) and the ADS1271B modulator output (FORMAT floating, SCLK and DOUT become outputs) are not; the FORMAT pin is not read

conversion time = 1 / data rate at fCLK = 27 MHz (Table 3): 256 tCLK high-speed (MODE = 0), 512 tCLK low-power (MODE = 1); MODE floating (high-resolution, 512 tCLK) reads 0 and gets the high-speed time; other CLK frequencies are not modeled; the CLK pin is not used
daisy-chain: the data shifted in on DIN after the 24 data bits are not passed through to DOUT (idle 0)

SYNC/PDWN: a short low pulse synchronizes (filter restart, DRDY high for 128 conversions tNDR); held low > 2^19 tCLK it powers down, then offset self-calibration and 256-conversion settling (tOFS); modeled as power-down while low

DRDY returns high on the first SCLK falling edge (modeled as cleared on reading the data); its high pulse before the next data when data are not read; DRDY held high for 128 conversions after a MODE change (tMD, tNDR)
variants: ADS1271IB parts are the B grade (adds the modulator output mode, FORMAT floating); same pinout and SPI / frame-sync interface
